feature_schema.distance_since_clean: Number of steps since a clean/surface-prep event.
feature_schema.distance_since_develop: Number of steps since photoresist develop.
feature_schema.numeric_unit_hints: Recipe/parameter snippets from reference rows, not per-lot measurements.
